summary: Join our Operational Risk and Crisis Management Training to develop critical skills for effective risk assessment and crisis response in your organization.
lede: Operational risk management training helps risk, continuity, and crisis professionals identify material risks and prepare critical services for disruption. Participants use risk-and-control assessments, FMEA, and bow-tie analysis to prioritize threats, map service impacts and recovery assumptions, and develop crisis escalation, communication, and recovery reporting practices.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess operational risk, maintain continuity capability, coordinate incidents, test controls, or report resilience exposure to decision-makers. It suits intermediate and advanced practitioners who need a common operating language across risk, continuity, security, audit, technology, and operations.
modules: Operational Risk Foundations and COSO ERM
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to operational processes, risk registers, internal controls, business continuity, audit, security operations, or incident management. No programming is required. Basic spreadsheet skills will help with the KRI and risk dashboard exercises. Advanced concepts such as AI-assisted incident triage and automated control monitoring are taught at operational application level, while ISO 22301 and Basel resilience principles are applied through templates and scenarios rather than full system implementation.
